document: per-finding map of the Codex review of guard qualification package v4 onto package v5 (DRAFT, unfrozen until the supervisor v9 source findings return; written only)
author: ContinueRQLS10b

findings.title: checker PASS does not establish artifact integrity or run binding
findings.v5: checker hashes every artifact itself (launch, stdout, stderr, samples, child output, receipt, settlement, staged link, config, GO, stability receipt, pinned files, interpreter) and compares with the receipt's artifact and evidence digests; config reconstructed exactly from the writer template (identical function body); per-invocation GO must list exactly this config sha with the exact entry; receipt/launch supervisor sha256 pinned to v9; settlement record bound to the receipt digest, failures and trips, and the same inode as .staged with two links; the parent-captured summary line bound by digests; mutate_evidence verified as exactly one appended byte; binding checks applied to UNSETTLED controls as well

findings.title: inexact reasons, counts, flags and JSON types
findings.v5: exact failure-code sets per scenario (including STREAMS_NOT_CLOSED / SINK_THREADS_NOT_FINISHED for escape_slow, escape_fast, ignore, identity), exact trips list, exact loop status, exact admission-reason sets for date_fault and go_unlisted, failures_n equal to the list length, signal and stop expectations; strict JSON rejects duplicates, NaN/Infinity and overflowing literals; booleans rejected in numeric fields; settlement and receipt representations compared

findings.title: samples incomplete; intended behaviour not demonstrated
findings.v5: samples non-empty, all strictly parsed with a census, count/bytes/digest/maxima equal to the receipt, strictly increasing monotonic time, lane_busy <= 2 (sampled evidence, stated as such); busy: IDS busy_pids [child, grandchild] equal to the busy pids of a sample with lane_busy 2 and of the BUSY trip detail; rss: IDS rss_pid and a sample with the trip's lane_rss above the threshold; flood: stream counters, file size and digest; zombie: the reported zombie pid in blocking_zombies; escapes: final census blocking set equals exactly the reported grandchild pid (double_fork reports it through a pipe); deadline: trip time and timeliness-bound arithmetic; positive controls: child output mode and pid, exact stdout
findings.supervisor_support: v9 census records lane_busy_pids and blocking_detail; BUSY trip detail carries the busy pids

findings.title: artifact confinement assumed
findings.v5: one fixed qualification root inside the lane validated before any creation; all arguments validated before creating anything; RUN must not pre-exist; every invocation artifact at a fixed path in RUN outside RUN/out; checker output fixed and exclusive; GO at RUN/go.json written exclusively by the parent; mutate targets exactly the scenario's fixture or own launch record, opened without create and without following symlinks, one link, fixture content verified

findings.title: self-termination and wall bounds overstated
findings.v5: child start time taken before the GO wait and the GO wait bounded by LIFE_S (select); non-blocking flood writes; double-fork grandchild sleeps only the remaining lifetime; descendants exit 1 with a traceback on error (no finally exit 0); plan separates nominal timing from enforced limits; pinned stability gate and observer references with their artifact boundary

findings.title: parent allocation, release and post-UNSETTLED disposition
findings.v5: plan v5 per-invocation transaction: exclusive authorization with current totals and slots (busy reserves both CPU slots; supervisor v9 cpu_slots binds it in the GO), per-invocation GO, run with captured summary, checker, read-only ended-process confirmation (no signals), late-artifact audit, new exclusive disposition record that alone releases; UNSETTLED receipts immutable; file existence, shell rc or checker PASS never advance the sequence

findings.title: stale checker identifier
findings.v5: checker reports guard_qual_check_v5 and exits 0 only for PASS; its sha256 is bound at package freeze

status: draft; to be frozen with the package after folding any interface corrections from the v9 source review
